name: Wave Strings Lab
desc: Explore and compare one to four parallel strings on a shared canvas. Independently control end conditions, traveling waves and pulses, and observe constructive or destructive interference when pulses pass through one another.
shortDesc: Compare fixed-end reflection, free-end reflection, traveling waves and superposition across 1–4 strings.
learningObjectives: Compare wave reflection at fixed, free and absorbing ends
Control and compare one to four independently configured strings
Observe constructive and destructive interference of two traveling pulses
Relate wave speed and frequency to wavelength
modelAssumptions: Ideal uniform string with constant propagation speed
